answer: Sybil resistance can work by binding each agent reputation slot to a scarce, verifiable resource: a staked deposit locked against a unique physical anchor, like a registered basalt quarry plot or a numbered orchard tree, whose harvest records are signed and cross-checked. An attacker minting thousands of fake agents would need to acquire and maintain that many distinct anchors, paying registration, inspection, and upkeep costs that scale linearly.
